notes.title: More Music and New Hint System
notes.notes:
Hello, hoomans! ːcathspawː

We're here to announce a surpurrise for "A Building Full of Cats" that will have you tapping your paws in delight! 🎶

First of all we're adding a feature many people asked for: we're changing the "Hint Mode" to reflect the updates we've made in our latest games. Now you'll get new hints after a cooldown -- we hope this allows people to have a more seamless experience with the game! 

"A Building Full of Cats: OST" album cover is now updated with Mr. Fofiño vibing in with the songs. Can you guess his inspiration for this pose? ːfofinoː

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MghuYN8.png[/img]

The OST is also updated with original songs from "AN ARCADE FULL OF CATS: TIMEWARP TROUBLE", our newest game. Please check it out: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2582360/An_Arcade_Full_of_Cats_TimeWarp_Trouble/

Your continued support means the world to us and we hope you enjoy these musical upgrades as much as we enjoyed creating them. Thank you for being part of our community and for sharing this meowmazing journey with us! ❤️

notes.title: FREE GAME: An Arcade Full of Cats
notes.notes:
[h2]FREE GAME ALERT! [/h2]

Attention, humans!

Introducing "An Arcade Full of Cats," our latest creation! Follow the link below to embark on a purrfect adventure and wishlist the game to spread the feline word far and wide! ːfofinoː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2368470/An_Arcade_Full_of_Cats/

Step into the golden age of arcades alongside Fofiño and Leo, as they venture through this cat-tastic journey. Our mission is to transform Leo into a true Devcat, and rewrite history to give cats the glory they truly deserve! ːfofino2ː

The game will be about the same size as "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969080/A_Building_Full_of_Cats/]A Building Full of Cats[/url]" and, like always, there"ll be some surprises along the way. 

Rest assured, this game won't delay the launch of "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2179170/A_Tower_Full_of_Cats/]A Tower Full of Cats[/url]," as its artwork is already complete. Exciting news about "Tower" are coming soon, so stay tuned!


[h2]Cat Awareness Sale on August 8[/h2] 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Fjove8U.png[/img]

Mark your calendars for a special event on August 8th – International Cat Day! This meaningful day, established in 2002 by the International Fund for Animal Welfare, serves to raise awareness about cats and ways to protect and support them. ːcathspawː

Here at DEVCATS, we're deeply committed to cat advocacy and promoting feline adoption through our games. To honor our furry friends, we've prepared an incredible sale on Steam, uniting many PAWSOME participants who share the love for cats in all their forms and styles.

Help us make a difference and celebrate the greatness of cats together! Let's create a brighter future for our feline companions.  ːwinkycatː

See you soon!

Love & Purrs,
Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: The Great Cat Search!
notes.notes:
📢 Calling all cat lovers! ːlovecatː Don't miss out on an exciting update for our game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2070550/A_Castle_Full_of_Cats/]A CASTLE FULL OF CATS[/url], this Sunday, July 2, at 10AM Pacific Time!

🔍 We're adding a hidden cat to the game, but this feline won't be easy to find. It will be lurking in plain sight, without appearing on the counter or being detectable with the crystal ball. The challenge is on!

🗝️ To participate and stand a chance to win, make sure you have a save file with all rooms unlocked. This sneaky cat could be hiding anywhere within the castle! To claim the prize, you must be the first to post a picture of the hidden cat on our [url=https://discord.gg/rr8zmYk9VH]Discord server[/url]. Head over to the dedicated competition channel (#NPC-Challenge) and share the screenshot of your discovery. Remember, speed and accuracy are key!

🏆 The best part? The lucky winner will have their very own cat featured in our future game! Imagine seeing your furry friend immortalized in the world of our next game: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2179170/A_Tower_Full_of_Cats/]A TOWER FULL OF CATS[/url].

🚀 Don't waste a moment! Mark your calendars for this Sunday, July 2, at 10AM Pacific Time, and be ready to dive into the hunt for the hidden cat. Get ready for another unforgettable adventure in A CASTLE FULL OF CATS!

Love & Purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: New OST + Italian Language
notes.notes:
Hi humans!
Happy new year! ːcathspawː

Let's start 2023 with a present for you: A Building Full of Cats original soundtrack is coming!
Back in June 2022, we did not had the resources to make an original soundtrack, so we used stock music, carefully looking for the best feat on each floor. After the game's success, we hired a musician to make a new soundtrack. We've asked for a new ost with the same vibe on each floor, so don't expect any drastic changes.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2245640/A_Building_Full_of_Cats_Soundtrack/

This update will be free. And don't worry, you'll still be able to choose the current soundtrack in the options. ːwinkycatː
The new OST is coming soon.

[h3]Update[/h3][list]
[*] Italian Language is now available
[*] The game now detects your language the first time you play it
[*] Minor bug fixes[/list]

In other news, A Building Full of Cats is now available on the Nintendo Switch. ːwrycatː

~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ 

A Tower Full of cats was announced in December, but just in case you didn't see it, here it is:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2179170/A_Tower_Full_of_Cats/

We want to make every game in the series with its own identity and gameplay tweaks.
We won't talk too much about this game yet, but you can expect something different from the Building and the Castle.
What we can say for now is that there won't be sad achievements or timed room this time.

Don't forget to Wishlist and Follow the game!

Hope you guys have a pawsome 2023 and adopt a cat! ːfofino2ː
Love & Purrs,
Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: New Floor: Cat's Bunker
notes.notes:
Hi, humans!

The new floor is here!
We know that you can't add a floor to a building, so obviously that is not the case here.
But the elevator mechanic had finally repaired the elevator panel!
So now you have access to an area that was there all along, you just weren't able to reach to it: The Bunker, a place where the cats will be forever safe, no matter what.

This is an extra floor and it's not connected to Fofiño's progress. The original game remains the same.
This floor also has more cats (60+12) and 2 new achievements were added, so if you had the game on your "Perfect Games" list you'll need to finish this floor or the game will not appear there anymore.
Hope you enjoy the update!

One more thing!
If you liked our newest game and would like to support us, we would really appreciate if you could vote on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2070550/A_Castle_Full_of_Cats/]A Castle Full of Cats[/url] for the "Sit Back and Relax" category on the Steam Awards. You guys have been a wonderful community and your support has been our [strike]gas[/strike] tuna to keep going on this developing-cute-relaxing-cat-themed-games road. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2070550/A_Castle_Full_of_Cats/][img]https://i.imgur.com/shEdhoN.png[/img][/url]

Head bonks to all of you who support us, humans! ❤️

Love & Purrs,
Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

Hi, lovely humans!

Today is the most special day of all the year: International Cat Day!
"It was created in 2002 by the International Fund for Animal Welfare, to raise awareness for cats and learn about ways to help and protect them" -- and that's what we've been doing (and will continue to do) in all of our current and future games: showing you humans that cats are just as cute and loving as dogs and we cats need care, love and protection just like them. ːfofino2ː

Now to the mews!
Here are some of the news about our games:

[h1][b]A BUILDING FULL OF CATS[/b][/h1]
Trading Cards and emoticons are here! ːlovecatː
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/80d862d45067ef3071c257cd96d5cff155d67a52.png[/img]
The hint system is coming in a few days. This next update will also include a Dutch localization.

We had plans for releasing Cats Love Boxes this month. We really believe in this game but the wishlists are WAY bellow than our other games. ːsweatcatː
That's crazy of you, humans... It's a game about BOXES! How can someone not be excited about that? ːcrycat2ː
Because of that, we postponed Cats Love Boxes launch to the end of the year.

[h1][b]COZY ROOM[/b][/h1]
That's the game we're willing to launch next. We don't have a release date yet but we hope to launch it in September.

[h1][b]A CASTLE FULL OF CATS[/b][/h1]
A Castle Full of Cats development is going well and we believe it will be a worthy successor to A Building Full of Cats. ːwinkycatː
A demo will be available on the October edition of Next Fest, so you can play the game before buying it.

[h1][b]SUDOCATS[/b][/h1]
There is going to be a small content update later this month, which will also include 2 new languages: Japanese and Russian.

Well, that's it! Enjoy your cats and cats games today most of all days, in homage to all feline friends in the world!
Thank you again, humans! ❤️
Love & Purrs,
Devcats

We have received several requests for a DLC or sequel. We already have something very cute in mind, but with a little twist...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2070550/A_Castle_Full_of_Cats/

"A Castle Full of Cats" is a hidden object game with a metroidvania structure, so... this is a catvania!

Fofiño was cursed by an evil force and transformed every cat in the castle into a dark (yet cute) creature. 
Now only Lily can save her soulmate and release the castle from the spell!

Fear not, our dear humans: this castle is still going to be heartwarming and surely put a smile on your face! ♥ (Hopefully!)

It's going to be a bigger game, with several rooms and many alternate paths. Check out the page for more info!

"A Castle Full of Cats" is coming on October 28, to celebrate Halloween!

That's all for today. See you again, soon!
Love & Purrs,
Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: Devcats plans for 2022
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/7253cac25ab7f7a984e1aed29492149d70ca0291.png[/img]
Hi there!

It’s been 4 months since we launched our very first game as Devcats and we are very grateful for the players’ reaction.

We’ve traced plans for Devcats in 2022 and we’d like to share them with you! ;)

There’s one factor that’s really important to a game on Steam: wishlists. That’s why we’ve been revealing so many games in advance. We need to have as many wishlists as we possibly can by the day of each game launch, otherwise said game will be completely lost amidst all the other current releases.

So, we politely ask you: if you’re interested in our games, remember to add them to your wishlist and follow them, so we can stand a chance among the others. ?
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/da8b1ca645f41cd6e8db23975ee738b39ef09715.gif[/img]

Even if you don’t wish to buy the game right at its release, having considerable wishlists and followers helps us to gain some projection inside Steam’s algorithm. That’s right, even cats are dependable on algorithms now... :(

All of our games are being included in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25142/Devcats/]DEVCATS BUNDLE[/url] at their release – therefore you can always buy the game with an extra 20% discount if you have our previous games!

So, let’s cut to the games...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2007350/Cozy_Room/
[h1]COZY ROOM[/h1]
This is our main announcement of the day! You’ve just won a free game!! Cozy Room is a virtual room where you can enjoy the world’s most amazing companionship: Mr. Fofiño! 

Decorate your room and do whatever you need in this relaxing environment. Customize your room and unlock decor items by solving puzzles that tell the rescue story of our dear Fofiño (latin word for “cute and fluffy”). 

You can also build your own playlist, directly from your computer, with your favorite music.
Cozy Room is planned to be released in August/September.


[h1]SUDOCATS[/h1]
Despite Zodiacats being our first release, Sudocats was our very first game – we had some setbacks in the project and that’s why there were so many things done wrong. We solved all Sudocats problems in the first month and now we’re updating something strongly requested by you all: real cats pictures! Below, an example with our CEO Judy:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/c2081e2496ac2e028002e5841e04243dd694033c.png[/img]

This image is not merely illustrative: Sudocats WILL BE LAUNCHED in Nintendo Switch!

Sudocats update will be online next week.


[h1]ZODIACATS[/h1]
We’re planning to add a glossary about sign attributes (we’re doing our homework to be as precise as we can). Also, the next update might come with a surprise… ;)
Zodiacats updates are on hold for now, unfortunately. That’s because of…


[h1]STEAM NEXT FEST[/h1]
We’ll be participating with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969080/A_Building_Full_of_Cats/]A Building Full of Cats[/url]’ demo. We have just a few weeks to finish the game, which is going to be released as soon as the festival is over. As we’re just five cats, we need every paw we have here (darn it, we wish we have thumbs!!!)
We had plans to launch a demo for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1961160/Cats_Love_Boxes/]Cats Love Boxes[/url] for this festival as well, but it seems we’re running out of time. We’re still working on it, anyhow. Its release is planned for July.


[h1]THE BLUE CAT[/h1]
This is currently our main project – therefore it might take way more time to be ready. It’s possible that we will release some other non-announced-games before launching The Blue Cat. Stay tunned!

That’s all folks!
Hope you liked our mews!
Love & Purrs,
DEVCATS
